name: Saucy Sausage, Sweet Potato & Beans
method: Peel the sweet potatoes and cut into 3cm cubes.
Brown the sausages and sweet potato in the oil in a large pan over a medium heat for about 5 minutes.
Turn the heat down, add the sliced onion, garlic, tomato puree and herbs and cook for a few minutes until the onion softens.
Add the drained beans and 250ml water, cover and cook for about 10 minutes until the potato is soft.
Finish with the grated lemon zest and a squeeze of juice.
